newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan contractor shares up after land auction.
newsitem.headline: Japan contractor shares up after land auction.

text.p: Shares of Japanese general contractors rose in Tuesday morning trade, boosted by hopes that the recent successful outcome of auctions of land in central Tokyo will spur development projects, brokers said.
As of 0146 GMT, shares of Taisei Corp were up 19 yen at 555. Obayashi Corp rose 27 yen to 712. Shimizu Corp added 33 yen to 828 and Kajima Corp 18 yen to 775.
"It has been a while since any large-scale development project plans have emerged and the construction sector 0#CON.T was inspired by it," a trader at a foreign brokerage said.
He added that the sector's shares had been underperforming recently and that there was ample room for a rebound.
